game.intro: New moon, new pencil case. Saturn sharpened every crayon in the studio and now dares you to zoom way, way in.
game.prompt: Something on your desk or table that has been sitting there since before summer started.

game.intro: The moon is in Libra, weighing everybody's choices. Tonight Saturn only weighs the wrong ones. Take your time.
game.question: How many sides does a stop sign have?

game.intro: Mischief on a Friday. The studio dryer is missing a sock and Mars is the prime suspect. Lend us your best sound effect.
game.prompt: A washing machine eating exactly one sock and feeling very pleased about it.

game.intro: Scorpio moon, secret pockets. Somebody's cardigan has been hiding something, and the presses are rolling.
game.headline: CARDIGAN FOUND TO CONTAIN ___, KNITTING CIRCLE CLAIMS IT KNEW ALL ALONG

game.intro: Don't even scream: two identical gnomes are watching this round from two different lawns. Guess bold, stay under.
game.question: A lawn gnome spins all the way around once to check who is watching. How many degrees did it turn?
game.source: Definition: one full rotation (a full circle) is 360 degrees.

game.intro: Labour Day. The crew has unionized in favour of hammocks. Three lazy choices, ten seconds each, no overthinking.
Back-to-school week, and the lunchbox has returned from exile. Pick yours, then guess what the other one grabbed.
game.question: Which lunchbox would ten-year-old you have defended with your whole heart?

game.intro: Somewhere a pair of sunglasses is giggling. Saturn would like photographic evidence of its hideout. Close. Closer.
game.prompt: The spot your lost sunglasses would hide if they secretly wanted to be found by Thursday.

game.intro: The moon climbs into Capricorn and Nancy's mountain holds the clipboard. Saturn grades on a curve made of nonsense.
game.question: What colour is a school bus?

game.intro: Capricorn moon, committee season. Saturn has called the meeting to order and the goat has the floor. Let us hear it.
game.prompt: A goat calling a very serious meeting to order with absolutely no gavel.

game.intro: Aquarius moon, inventor's junk drawer wide open. Build us a gadget out of nothing but little pictures.
game.prompt: An invention the world clearly needs but nobody has bothered to build yet.

game.intro: DES alert: the rubber ducks are organized. Two of your floaty facts are true, one is pure bathwater. Nobody quack.
game.prompt: Three things you have found floating somewhere they had no business floating.

game.intro: The moon is almost full and still practising its entrance. Quick rehearsal, three cues, ten seconds a cue.
The full moon showed up a day early with a casserole. Tell us your arrival style, then guess your partner in crime's.
game.question: Be honest: how do you arrive at a party?

game.intro: Full Moon Recharge night. Ruby and onyx are sunbathing in moonlight, so you two zoom in on something luminous.
game.prompt: Something in your home that glows after dark and is not a screen.

game.intro: The moon is visiting Joel's sign and the Tiger has put out snacks. Answer boldly, answer wrongly, answer with fire.
game.question: What sound does a tiger make?

game.intro: Thermostat wars have begun. Saturn sides with whoever gives the most dramatic impression. Fire it up.
game.prompt: The furnace kicking on for the first time since spring, with a lot of feelings about it.

game.intro: Waning moon, letting-go Saturday. Today's front page releases something into the wild. Fill in the blank gently.
game.headline: AREA FRIENDS RELEASE ___ BACK INTO THE WILD AFTER ELEVEN YEARS, IT SEEMS FINE

game.intro: Don't even scream, the marmalade predicted this exact question. Guess under, and keep the toast away from the tiles.
game.question: Add up every pip on all 28 tiles of a standard double-six domino set. What is the total?
game.source: Double-six set: each value 0-6 appears 8 times across the 28 tiles, so 8 x (0+1+...+6) = 8 x 21 = 168.

game.intro: Taurus moon, stubborn seedling, slow Monday. Three cozy picks, ten seconds each, then back to your blanket.
Gemini moon, hat-swapping season. Pick a career to borrow for a day, then guess which hat the other one grabbed.
game.question: You must swap hats with one of these for a whole day. Who?

game.intro: Happy half-birthday, Spring Tiger. Six months to go, so today Saturn only wants to see things that are half done.
game.prompt: Something in your home that is exactly half full, half done or halfway finished.

game.intro: Equinox! The cabin door creaks open for autumn. Saturn has one very easy question and wants it gloriously wrong.
game.question: What season begins on the autumn equinox?

game.intro: Blanket fort revival night. The structural engineer is Saturn and he is not impressed. Give us the soundtrack.
game.prompt: A blanket fort collapsing politely, one cushion at a time.

game.intro: Leo moon, roar practice. The lion wants proof of courage, but only in tiny pictures. Brave little emoji only.
game.prompt: The bravest small thing you did this week.

game.intro: Don't even scream: two matching sun-faced kites, one sky. Two of your sky facts are true, one drifted in from fiction.
game.prompt: Three things you saw up in the sky this month: clouds, birds or something stranger.

game.intro: Virgo moon, colour-coded Monday. The studio label maker is warm. Three tidy picks, ten seconds each.
Dark moon, quiet hour. The crew has dimmed the studio lights. Choose your silence and guess the other's.
game.question: You get sixty perfectly silent minutes. Where do you spend them?

game.intro: New moon, brand-new notebook. Saturn loves a first page. Show us one so close we can almost smell the paper.
game.prompt: The first page of something: a notebook, a book, a calendar, a recipe card.

game.intro: Last day of the golden month. Saturn is packing up September and accepting only the wrongest of answers.
game.question: What month comes after September?
